title: AgentTeamRunResponse
description: Response containing a single Agent Team run.

data.description: The primary data of the document

name.description: Name of the Agent Team input.

AgentTeamInput.description: Input parameter passed to an Agent Team run.

id.description: The unique identifier for the resource

meta.description: Non-standard meta information about the resource

AgentTeamRun.description: Model describing an Agent Team run

agentTeamId.description: The unique identifier of the Agent Team associated with this run.

status.description: Current execution status of the Agent Team run.

inputs.description: The inputs provided for this run of the Agent Team

output.description: Final or in-progress output for the Agent Team run. This field is omitted for runs that have not yet produced output.

AgentTeamRunAttributes.description: Attributes describing an Agent Team run

createdAt.description: The UTC date time when the Agent Team run was created

createdBy.description: The id of the user that executed this Agent Team run

updatedAt.description: The UTC date time when the Agent Team run was last updated

completedAt.description: The UTC date time when the Agent Team run completed

totalCredits.description: The total number of credits consumed by this Agent Team run. This value is only provided after the Agent Team has successfully finished executing

AgentTeamRunMeta.description: Metadata information for an Agent Team run

AgentTeamRunStatus.description: Lifecycle states for an Agent Team run.

x-enumDescriptions.QUEUED: The Agent Team run is queued and waiting to start.
x-enumDescriptions.RUNNING: The Agent Team run is currently executing.
x-enumDescriptions.COMPLETED: The Agent Team run completed successfully.
x-enumDescriptions.FAILED: The Agent Team run completed with a failure.
x-enumDescriptions.CANCELLED: The Agent Team run was stopped before completion.
x-enumDescriptions.STOPPING: The Agent Team run is currently in the process of shutting down
